component.name: PDF Signer
component.summary: Fill in, sign, redact and watermark PDFs

description.p: PDF Signer fills in and signs PDF forms entirely on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: Type text, add dates and checkmarks anywhere on a page
Place your signature from an image; the paper background is removed automatically
Redact: black out content and remove it from the file for good
Stamp a watermark across every page

description.p: Automatic updates: new versions are downloaded in the background, verified against the project's signing key, and installed on restart.
